text: CCM Hockey is majority-owned by Swedish private equity firm Altor Equity Partners, which bought a majority stake from Birch Hill Equity Partners in a deal announced in October 2024 and completed around the turn of 2024-25, with Northleaf Capital Partners as co-investor.
short: CCM Hockey majority-owned by Altor Equity Partners

source.name: Sportico: Nordic Private Equity Firm Buys CCM Hockey Majority Stake
source.quote: Altor is taking a majority stake in CCM Hockey, the skates, equipment and accessories manufacturer that has outfitted players for over a century.

additionalSources.name: Northleaf Capital Partners: Northleaf Completes Investment in CCM Hockey Alongside Altor Equity Partners
additionalSources.quote: Northleaf partnered with Altor Equity Partners ("Altor"), a leading European middle-market private equity firm, to acquire the business.
